summary: git_repo_root must thread via spec.extra at every real launch site, not args-side helper alone
evidence: Plan §4.5 names dispatch_issue.py ~374 (SLURM reconnect path), but the GCP launch builds the declaration in GcpBackend._with_artifacts_declaration → expected_artifacts_declaration(spec=...) (gcp.py:4256) and RunPod reads spec.extra.get('wandb_run_path') (runpod.py:297). Same pattern as wandb_run_path: store into spec.extra['git_repo_root'] at _launch_extra_from_args time, read off spec.extra in each backend's launch(), forward to the builder. Thread ALL real launch sites + the slurm reconnect.
